name: Multilevel Model HLM2 (2 levels)
when_to_use: Hierarchical data on 2 levels (e.g., students within schools), metric dependent variable; decomposes within- and between-group variance (ICC).

expected_input.question: How to decompose variance between and within hierarchical levels?

plain_explanation.purpose: Does regression while respecting that items live in groups (group effect + individual effect).
plain_explanation.when_to_use_plain: When the data are nested on two levels and items in the same group resemble each other.
plain_explanation.data_needed: A table with one item per row, a column telling the group and factor columns for both levels.
plain_explanation.example: Explain student scores taking each student's school into account.
plain_explanation.diagram: Level 2: school -> Level 1: students within the school
